title: Derived tensor notation
statement:
Fix a scheme $Y$ and a commutative ring $A$, and use the small pro-etale site
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, with its constant sheaf of rings $A_Y$, the abelian category of $A_Y$-modules and $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ as defined there. A complex $P$
of $A_Y$-modules is *K-flat* if tensoring it with every acyclic complex
preserves acyclicity, that is, it is K-flat in the sense of [def-pc-kflat-complex] for the ringed site $(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_Y)$. For complexes $K_1,K_2$ of $A_Y$-modules, choose a
quasi-isomorphism $P\to K_1$ with $P$ K-flat (one exists by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]) and define

$$
 K_1\otimes_A^L K_2=P\otimes_A K_2
$$

(the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] over $A_Y$) regarded as an object of $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$. For a ring map $A\to B$ and a complex $K_1$,
write $K_1\otimes_A^L B$ for derived tensor with the constant $B_Y$-module, regarded as an $A_Y$-module by restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] along the induced map $A_Y\to B_Y$.

split_report.summary: Statement checked against its blueprint source (master; Lean state none on both branches) and against Stacks 06YN/06YS/06YU (sites-cohomology.tex, Section 06YL), of which it is the special case of the ringed site (Y_proet, A_Y). Kept the text and named the notions it is built from: the K-flat notion (new def-pc-kflat-complex, ringed site, Stacks 06YN, not in Mathlib), the existence of a K-flat resolution that the choice of P needs (new lem-pc-kflat-resolution, Stacks 06YS, not in Mathlib), the total tensor complex P (x)_A K_2 (new def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, Mathlib leaf via HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor over def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product), and the A_Y-module structure of B_Y (new def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, Mathlib leaf SheafOfModules.restrictScalars); the site, A_Y, B_Y, quasi-isomorphisms and D(Y_proet,A) come from def-weil-pbc-proetale-site. Independence of the choice of P is not needed to define the object (the definition takes a chosen P); it is the existing node lem-weil-derived-tensor-resolution-independent, which depends on this one.
